title: 第26章 摸鱼这门手艺
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
第二天早上安槐买了两份豆浆油条到苏念念家门口的时候，发现她已经站在巷口等着了。

    难得，今天她没迟到。

    更难得的是，她居然换了一条新马尾绳，深蓝色的，上面缀着一个小小的星星吊坠。

    安槐递过早饭。

    “老大今天精神不错。”

    “废话，全年级第二的人哪能没精神。”苏念念接过油条咬了一口，嚼了两下忽然凑近看他的脸，“你昨晚干什么了？黑眼圈。”

    “练功。”

    “练到几点？”

    “两点。”

    苏念念伸手拧了一下他的耳朵。

    “说了多少次了不要熬夜！你以为你是铁打的？”

    安槐偏头躲了一下没躲掉，耳朵被她拧得微微发红。

    “下次注意。”

    “你每次都说下次注意。”苏念念松开手，嘴里叼着油条含含糊糊地骂，“死心眼的家伙。”

    安槐揉了揉耳朵，笑了笑。

    到了学校，教室里的气氛跟之前不太一样了。

    排位赛之后，安槐和苏念念的名字在全年级基本家喻户晓，安槐是毫无悬念的第一，大家已经习惯了对这个银灰色头发的猛人感到绝望。

    苏念念则是最大的黑马，一个四重选手杀进全年级第二，打赢了好几个比她修为高的对手，战斗方式漂亮得像在看武道教学片。

    走进教室的时候，前排几个男生齐刷刷回头。

    “苏同学早！”

    “安槐早！”

    苏念念大方地挥了挥手，安槐点了点头。

    坐到座位上，苏念念翻开课本，翻了两页就合上了。

    “安槐，我觉得排位赛结束之后上课好无聊。”

    “知识不会因为你打赢了比赛就变简单。”

    “你说这话跟我妈一模一样。”

    安槐翻开自己的课本，开始默默温习固元淬体诀的运转路径，表面上在看课本，实际上脑子里在推演灵步残影的第二式步法。

    苏念念趴在桌上偏头看他。

    “你又在偷偷练功。”

    “我在看书。”

    “你眼睛没对焦，瞳孔微微放大，呼吸频率比正常看书时慢了一拍。你在运内功。”

    安槐的手指在课本上停了一下。

    “老大什么时候学会观察这些细节的？”

    “跟你待了十年，你的每个小动作我都门清。”苏念念得意地哼了一声，“别以为你藏得住。”

    安槐看着她，忽然笑了。

    “那老大觉得我现在在想什么？”

    苏念念盯着他的眼睛看了三秒钟。

    “你在想怎么变得更强。”

    安槐微微挑眉。

    “怎么看出来的？”

    “因为你每次看着我然后笑的时候，要么在想跟我有关的事，要么在想怎么保护我。你这个笑是后者。”

    安槐沉默了一瞬。

    十年。

    她看了他十年。
content_en:
The next morning, when An Huai bought two soy milk and fried dough sticks and arrived at the door of Su Niannian's house, he found that she was already waiting at the entrance of the alley.

It's rare that she was not late today.

What's even more rare is that she actually changed into a new ponytail rope, dark blue, with a small star pendant on it.

An Huai handed over breakfast.

"Boss is in good spirits today."

"Nonsense, how can someone who is second in the grade lose his energy?" Su Niannian took the dough stick and took a bite. After chewing twice, she suddenly looked closer at his face and said, "What did you do last night? There are dark circles under your eyes."

"Practice."

"How long will it take to practice?"

"Two o'clock."

Su Niannian reached out and pinched his ears.

"How many times have I told you not to stay up late! Do you think you are made of iron?"

An Huai tilted her head to avoid it, and her ears turned slightly red from being pinched by her.

"Be careful next time."

"You always tell me to be careful next time." Su Niannian let go of her hand and cursed vaguely with a fried dough stick in her mouth, "You're a stubborn guy."

An Huai rubbed his ears and smiled.

When I arrived at school, the atmosphere in the classroom was different from before.

After the qualifying round, An Huai and Su Niannian's names became basically household names in the whole grade. An Huai was ranked first without any suspense. Everyone was used to despairing of this silver-gray-haired fierce man.

Su Niannian is the biggest dark horse. A quadruple player reached the second place in the grade. She defeated several opponents who were more advanced than her. Her fighting style was as beautiful as watching a martial arts instructional film.

When he walked into the classroom, the boys in the front row all turned their heads.

"Good morning, classmate Su!"

"Good morning An Huai!"

Su Niannian waved her hand generously, and An Huai nodded.

After sitting on her seat, Su Niannian opened the textbook, flipped through two pages and closed it.

"An Huai, I think class is so boring after qualifying."

“Knowledge doesn’t become easier just because you win the game.”

"What you said was exactly the same as my mother's."

An Huai opened his textbook and began to silently review the operation path of the Gu Yuan Tempering Body Technique. On the surface, he was reading the textbook, but in fact, he was deducing the second step of the spiritual step afterimage in his mind.

Su Niannian lay on the table and looked at him.

"You're practicing secretly again."

"I'm reading a book."

"Your eyes are out of focus, your pupils are slightly dilated, and your breathing rate is a beat slower than normal when reading. You are using internal energy."

An Huai's fingers paused on the textbook.

"When did Boss learn to observe these details?"

"Having been with you for ten years, I know every little move you make." Su Niannian snorted proudly, "Don't think you can hide it."

An Huai looked at her and suddenly smiled.

"Then what do you think I'm thinking about now, boss?"

Su Niannian stared into his eyes for three seconds.

"You're thinking about how to become stronger."

An Huai raised his eyebrows slightly.

"How can you tell?"

"Because every time you look at me and smile, you are either thinking about something related to me, or you are thinking about how to protect me. Your smile is the latter."

An Huai was silent for a moment.

ten years.

She watched him for ten years.
